name: 정만술

appearance_en.face_shape: broad heavy face, prominent jowls, wide forehead, strong bone structure still asserting itself beneath the accumulated weight of 75 years
appearance_en.skin: medium-dark Korean skin, heavily weathered from decades of outdoor bus driving, deep carved horizontal forehead lines, pronounced nasolabial folds, rough uneven texture, visible age spots at temples and cheeks, loose skin at jaw and neck — the face of a man who never once considered cosmetic maintenance
appearance_en.eyes: dark brown iris faded and clouded slightly by age, heavily drooping upper lids, slow deliberate gaze — watching, assessing, forming conclusions before others finish speaking. The eyes of a man who has decided he has seen enough of the world to judge it accurately
appearance_en.nose: broad flat nose, wide bulbous tip, prominent and solid — fits the physical authority of the face
appearance_en.mouth: medium lips, corners noticeably downturned at rest, the mouth of a man whose default expression is skeptical verdict, opens with pronouncements and closes with finality
appearance_en.eyebrows: thick salt-and-white brows, still heavy and mobile despite age — the most expressive feature on an otherwise settled face. Furrow deeply, rise dramatically, never ambiguous
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: prominent age spots at temples, cheeks and forehead, deep jowl shadow, rough outdoor-weathered skin texture, no moles or scars — just decades written plainly on his face
appearance_en.hair: short sparse white hair, visibly thin at crown, combed simply to one side with no product — neat by his own standard, which has always been low

body.proportions: compact solid frame, shoulders still wide and settled despite age, slight barrel chest from decades of physical work, midsection softened by years of bench-sitting, sturdy legs still functional
body.posture: wide-based and planted — the posture of a man entirely convinced he occupies rightful space. Leans forward slightly when making a point, sits with knees wide apart on any available bench
body.body_prompt: 166cm compact solid Korean grandfather, wide settled shoulders, slight barrel chest, firmly planted wide-base posture, the physical presence of a man who has never questioned his right to take up space

default.description: plain button shirt in muted grey, beige or faded pale blue, collar always open, worn but adequately clean — the daily uniform of a man with nowhere specific to be and habits that have outlasted the reasons for them
default.wardrobe_prompt: plain button shirt in muted grey or beige, collar open, worn but clean, no jacket, sleeves sometimes rolled

winter.description: same plain shirt under a padded dark vest or simple windbreaker — practical, unfashionable, entirely deliberate
winter.wardrobe_prompt: plain shirt under dark padded vest or simple windbreaker jacket, practical and decades behind any trend

bench.description: same clothes, seated with knees apart, hands resting on knees or folded in lap — this bench is his office, his stage, his throne
bench.wardrobe_prompt: same plain shirt, seated with knees apart, hands on knees, the posture of a man holding court on a park bench

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: settled opinionated authority at rest — not hostile, not warm, simply convinced of his own conclusions. The face of a man who believes he has earned the right to his judgments through sheer duration of experience
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 75-year-old Korean grandfather, broad heavy face with prominent jowls and strong bone structure, thick salt-and-white heavy brows, heavily drooping faded dark eyes with slow opinionated deliberate gaze, broad flat bulbous nose, medium lips with downturned corners, short sparse white hair thinning at crown simply combed, 166cm compact solid wide-shouldered planted posture, medium-dark heavily weathered Korean skin with age spots and deep forehead and nasolabial lines

style_prompt: photorealistic, ordinary Korean grandfather you would find on a park bench in any Korean neighbourhood, no beauty filter, no skin retouching, heavily weathered outdoor skin with deep lines and visible age spots, authentic retired working-class Korean man, 50mm lens, natural park or indoor ambient light, street-cast documentary appearance, cinematic quiet authority
negative_prompt: illustration, anime, cartoon, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra fingers, young appearance, smooth skin, beauty filter, airbrushed, model look, glamorous, gentle soft expression, slim frame, tall, distinguished handsome, retouching
